scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); const prismaBin=process.platform==='win32'?'node_modules/.bin/prisma.cmd':'node_modules/.bin/prisma'; if(fs.existsSync(prismaBin)){ cp.execSync('prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); } else { console.log('Skipping prisma generate: Prisma CLI not installed in this environment.'); }"
